values.value: Assessments are entered as drafts and published; published results are locked and graded with the grade bands (A+ from 90%, A 80%, B 70%, C 60%, D 50%, F below). Course grades are the weighted average of published assessments. Absent counts as zero when {{Setting:Absent_Counts_As_Zero}} is true. Finalising grades locks them and issues a report card PDF to each family; grades can be reopened by coordinators or administrators with a reason.
